_about: Measurable feel targets for Hermes Arena. Each metric is measured per fighter by lab.cjs. 'target' is the pass band, 'warn' the outer band (warn = half credit). Bands come from Smash Ultimate frame data scaled to this stage, or from Justin's notes. Change a band only with a reason in LOG.md.

jumpsquat_f.label: Jumpsquat (frames from press to airborne)
jumpsquat_f.why: Ultimate: 3 f for every fighter. Longer feels sluggish.

fullhop_air_f.label: Full hop airtime (f)
fullhop_air_f.why: Ultimate mid-weights: ~45-55 f. Too long feels floaty, too short twitchy.

shorthop_air_f.label: Short hop airtime (f)
shorthop_air_f.why: Room for one aerial plus its landing; Ultimate ~30-36 f.

hop_ratio.label: Short hop height / full hop height
hop_ratio.why: Short hop must feel clearly lower (Ultimate ~0.5).

fullhop_vs_sideplat.label: Full hop apex / side platform height
fullhop_vs_sideplat.why: A full hop should comfortably reach the side platforms.

dj_vs_topplat.label: Full hop + double jump apex / top platform height
dj_vs_topplat.why: Two jumps should reach the top platform.

cross_f.label: Run across the altar (f)
cross_f.why: Ultimate mid-speed runners cross a battlefield-sized stage in ~1.2-1.7 s; scaled to this altar.

ff_ratio.label: Fast fall speed / normal fall speed

turn_f.label: Run turnaround (f until moving the other way)
turn_f.why: Skid makes runs committal but not sticky.

buffer_delay_f.label: Buffered follow-up delay after the cancel frame (f)
buffer_delay_f.why: A press made early must fire on the first free frame.

air_speed_ratio.label: Top air speed / run speed
air_speed_ratio.why: Smash fighters drift slower than they run (Mario 0.69); full run speed in the air makes recoveries and approaches too free.

air_turn_f.label: Air drift reversal (f to half speed the other way)
air_turn_f.why: Responsive but with momentum; Mario ~18 f.

air_stop_f.label: Air friction: f until drift falls to 20% after letting go
air_stop_f.why: Letting go of the stick should slow the drift; with no air friction you keep flying sideways.

recovery_h.label: Horizontal recovery from stage level (share of stage width)
recovery_h.why: Battlefield proportions: mid-weights recover from ~0.6-0.75 stage widths; from the blast line (1.14) means nobody can be edge-guarded.

recovery_v.label: Vertical recovery below the ledge (body heights)
recovery_v.why: Up special plus jumps should save you from a low launch but not from the bottom blast line.

hitlag10_f.label: Hitlag on a 10% hit (f)
hitlag10_f.why: Ultimate: 0.65 f per % plus a base. Sells impact.

bthrow_ko.label: Back throw KO % at the ledge
bthrow_ko.why: Throws kill late; a back throw at the edge is the best one.

tumble_ftilt.label: Damage where forward tilt starts to tumble (%)
tumble_ftilt.why: Low % hits should keep the foe close; mid % starts real launches.

utilt_chain.label: Up tilt true-combo hits on itself from 0%
utilt_chain.why: Juggles at low %, but no infinites.

max_chain.label: Longest true combo of one repeated ground move (any %)

dthrow_adv20.label: Down throw frame advantage at 20% (f)
dthrow_adv20.why: Down throw is the combo starter at low %.

framedata_inband.label: Moves inside their frame-data band (%)
framedata_inband.why: See FRAME_BANDS in lab.cjs: startup and shield advantage per move class.

timeout_rate.label: Share of matches that hit the 4 min cap
timeout_rate.why: Stalemates mean KOs are too hard to land.

self_destructs.label: Share of KOs with no hit in the prior 4 s
self_destructs.why: CPU falling off on its own is not a fight.

kofx_false.label: Share of KO slow-motion moments where nobody was KO'd
kofx_false.why: The slow motion and zoom promise a KO. Until v31 it fired on 63% of strong hits that the victim simply recovered from.
kofx_false.source: design; Smash's KO zoom is rarely wrong

kofx_missed.label: Share of KOs off a hit that got no slow motion
kofx_missed.why: A kill should get its moment.

big_stall.label: Big map: share of match time with no hit for over 8 s
big_stall.why: On Kyllene two CPUs stood on either side of a chasm, each stepping off and turning back, for up to a minute at a time (v31: Aethon 0.6, Hermes 0.3).

big_self_destructs.label: Big map: share of KOs with no hit in the prior 4 s
big_self_destructs.why: The big map has pits inside the stage; a CPU that drops into them on its own is not a fight.

stuck.label: Fighters stuck in one state > 5 s
